name: mini-sql-editor

scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit && tsc -p shared/tsconfig.lib.json && tsc -p shared/tsconfig.test.json && tsc -p client/tsconfig.app.json && tsc -p client/tsconfig.test.json
scripts.test: tsx --tsconfig tsconfig.tsx.json --test server/*.test.ts shared/*.test.ts client/src/*.test.ts client/src/*.test.tsx client/src/*/*.test.ts client/src/*/*.test.tsx server/integration/*.test.ts
scripts.test:unit: tsx --tsconfig tsconfig.tsx.json --test server/*.test.ts shared/*.test.ts client/src/*.test.ts client/src/*.test.tsx client/src/*/*.test.ts client/src/*/*.test.tsx
scripts.test:watch: tsx --tsconfig tsconfig.tsx.json --test --watch server/*.test.ts shared/*.test.ts client/src/*.test.ts client/src/*.test.tsx client/src/*/*.test.ts client/src/*/*.test.tsx

author: Scott Brabson
description: A mini SQL editor for ClickHouse: run queries and scripts, chart the results, insert data from a file
